name: Week 18 KB Full Body — Figure-8 Flow (Back) + GymVibe 9-Min AMRAP (New) (Spotlight: Thruster)
description: KB Tuesday, two sections — a flow and a workout. The Leggy Flow rotates OUT; this week brings back the figure-8 → tactical clean complex (the user missed it) as the skill flow section, then introduces the GymVibe 9-minute AMRAP as the strength/conditioning workout section — ballistic row → thruster → reverse-lunge-to-knee-drive, run back-to-back on a 30 → 40 → 50lb load ladder for as many rounds as possible in 9 minutes. The leg-athletic + overhead-pressing work sits on Tuesday, three days clear of Friday legs. Spotlight is the thruster — the new move and the day's overhead shoulder-relevant lift. Wrapped in the settled Tuesday scaffolding (warm-up + banded prep in, pigeon/butterfly cooldown out).

watchpoints: **Two sections: skill flow + workout.** The figure-8 complex is the light-bell skill flow (returning by request); the GymVibe AMRAP is the strength/conditioning workout. Don't skip the workout section — KB Tuesday carries both.

**Figure-8 → tactical clean is a FLOW** — the pass exits INTO the clean (the bell doesn't return to a hand mid-pass). Practice slow before adding load; keep it light/medium, it's the skill warm-up to the AMRAP.
**GymVibe AMRAP load ladder: 30 → 40 → 50lb** over the three 3-minute thirds — groove the pattern light, climb to the top bell. Swap up at the 3- and 6-minute marks. Single bell.

**The thruster press is the limiter AND the shoulder risk** — pack the shoulder DOWN on the lockout; if 50 won't press clean by the last third, hold 40 and chase rounds instead. Lighten the bell before the press gets ugly.
**Leg-athletic + overhead, and that's fine** — it's Tuesday, three days clear of Friday legs. The reverse-lunge-to-knee-drive is the leggy piece; it lives here on purpose.
**Protective behind-back shrug greasing set stays in the warm-up** — 1 light set, easy to forget.
**Trim for time:** the figure-8 flow can drop to 2 rounds and the AMRAP can run 6 min instead of 9 if the session's long — count rounds + where the bell got heavy.

exercises.notes: **LOAD:** 15-20lb. Big slow circles both directions — open the shoulders before the work.
**LOAD:** 20lb. Light — test the overhead position before the thruster work. If anything cracks/twinges, add band work before starting.
**LOAD:** 25lb. Open the hips, sit in the bottom for a beat — previews the thruster squat.
Standing, torso hinged slightly forward. Tight fists with thumbs tucked, rotate the wrists internally and hold the tension — primes grip and forearms for the figure-8 catches + the AMRAP.

exercises.equipment: light DB pair or a kettlebell held behind the body
exercises.notes: **Protective shrug (greasing set) — the pull-day shrug, scattered to KB days.** 1 light set held behind the body, palms back. Pack the shoulders DOWN and BACK, shrug UP and slightly back, 1s peak squeeze, slow down. The 'opposite movement' that decompresses the right shoulder — costs nothing, easy to forget.

sets.name: Banded Shoulder Prep (~3 min)

exercises.notes: Mini-band OR blue rope band held in hands.
Elbows drive to the ribs, scaps depress.
Don't overarch the lower back to chase range.
15s each side. Primes the overhead + rotation.
Both arms in a V/Y, hold and breathe. Lower traps fire — primes the thruster lockout.

sets.notes: 1 round of all 7 banded moves (~3 min). Sustained tension, no rest between positions.

sets.name: 🌀 Figure-8 → Tactical Clean Flow (Returning Favorite — Skill Section)

exercises.notes: **LOAD:** 15-20lb. Warm-up pass — get the hand-switch grooved before the figure-8. Core tight, torso quiet, smooth and continuous.

**LOAD:** medium bell (~26-35lb). 3 rounds, ~30-45s of the complex each.

**The returning favorite — the pass exits INTO the clean:**
- **START in hike position** (bell between the legs, hinged)
- **Figure-8 pass between the legs exits INTO a tactical clean to the rack** on one side — the catch behind becomes the clean, no 'land and re-grip'
- **Lower the bell back through hike**
- **Next figure-8 pass switches hands → clean to rack on the other side**
- **Continue alternating** — hike is home base; if you lose the bell, get back to hike before re-starting
- **Tactical clean = controlled, threaded into the rack** — no banging the forearm, no momentum hack

**This is the skill flow, not a grinder** — keep it light/medium and smooth; it warms the pattern + grip for the AMRAP. Reflection: does the figure-8 exit cleanly into the rack catch, or are you re-gripping mid-pass?

sets.notes: **Skill flow section — the figure-8 → tactical clean complex, back by request.** Light/medium bell, 3 rounds, smooth and continuous. The pass-through is where the hands switch; the clean is where the skill builds. Canonical source: kb-figure-8-tactical-clean-complex (@kettleclubfam). Keep it light — it's the warm-up to the workout section, not the workout.

sets.name: 🔆💪 GymVibe 9-Min AMRAP (Workout Section — Spotlight: Thruster)

exercises.notes: **Ballistic row — explosive, not a slow controlled row.** Hinge at the hips, back flat, drive the bell to the hip with power, then control it back. 8 per side. Brace the core, no torso rotation.

**🔆 SPOTLIGHT — goblet squat → press in one motion (the source's 'goblet cluster'):**
- **Bell at the chest/goblet**, squat to at least parallel
- **Drive up and let the leg momentum power the press overhead** — the legs press it, not just the shoulders; that timing is the skill
- **Lock out tall, ribs down, pack the shoulder DOWN** — then back into the next squat
- **Right-shoulder watch on the overhead** — if it won't lock out clean, this is the move to lighten first; hold 40 and chase rounds rather than grind an ugly 50 press

**Reflection:** does the leg drive carry the press (clean lockout), or are the shoulders grinding it up once the bell gets heavy? The leg-driven press is the win.

Step back to a reverse lunge → drive the back knee forward and up to a tall, balanced stand → repeat. Drive through the FRONT heel, stay tall. 8 per side. The leg-athletic piece — lives on Tuesday, far from Friday legs.

sets.notes: **AMRAP — as many rounds of the three moves as possible in 9 minutes, NO rest between moves or rounds.** Single bell. **Load ladder over the three thirds:** 0:00-3:00 @ 30lb → 3:00-6:00 @ 40lb → 6:00-9:00 @ 50lb (swap the bell up at the 3- and 6-min marks). Builds into the top weight instead of opening on your max. The thruster's overhead press is the limiter — if 50 won't press clean by the last third, hold 40 and chase rounds. Count total rounds + where you were when the bell got heavy. (Source: @gymvibe_. Trim to 6 min if the session's running long.)

exercises.notes: 60s each side. Hip flexor release — counters the lunge + hike work.
60s. Adductors get tight from the wide-stance figure-8 + the lunges.
